gloss: to mediate, to act as go-between, to introduce

definitions.gloss: to mediate, to act as go-between, to introduce
definitions.explanation: To serve as an intermediary between two parties, often to help them connect or reach an agreement.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}が{二人|ふたり}の{仲|なか}を{取|と}り{持|も}ってくれた。
examples.english: A friend acted as go-between for the two of them.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}{同士|どうし}の{取引|とりひき}を{取|と}り{持|も}つ{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たした。
examples.english: I played the role of mediating business deals between companies.

notes:
{取|と}り{持|も}つ means to act as an intermediary between parties.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: Xを{取|と}り{持|も}つ / Xの{間|あいだ}を{取|と}り{持|も}つ

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {縁|えん}を{取|と}り{持|も}つ: to play matchmaker
- {仲|なか}を{取|と}り{持|も}つ: to mediate between parties
- {間|あいだ}を{取|と}り{持|も}つ: to act as go-between

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {仲介|ちゅうかい}する: to mediate (more formal)
- {橋渡|はしわた}しをする: to bridge (figurative)
- {斡旋|あっせん}する: to arrange, to introduce
